summary_md:
# SKF röstar om Vertevo – Ericssons nya vd tillträder

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon kicked off Q4 with the Stockholm exchange set to open lower. The oil price is back under $100 but interest rates are still high, which the hosts see as a headwind. They discussed SKF's EGM vote to spin off its automotive business Vertevo, Per Narvinger's first day as Ericsson CEO (where the loss-making Enterprise/Vonage unit is the main problem) and a series of analyst rating changes. The main discussion was on Nordic big banks: guest Lasse Söderfjell (Ålandsbanken) is constructive and expects about 15% total return at relatively low risk. Nordea is his largest position, and he prefers SEB, Danske and DNB over Swedbank and Handelsbanken.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NDA-SE — Nordea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest Lasse Söderfjell's largest bank position: low valuation, clear capital policy, Nordic exposure.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Banks have stable, higher net interest income than in the zero-rate era, ~7% annual EPS growth to 2028, near 5% yield, so ~15% expected total return at low risk. Nordea is preferred for its low valuation and clear capital allocation. Banks beat expectations 59 of the last 68 quarters, though Nordea's trading income caused most misses.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates fall back toward zero
- if credit losses rise
- if the domestic economy weakens

> *"Jag tycker att Nordea är den som vi har den största positionen i. Delvis därför att den är lågt värderad"*

---

### 🟢 SEB-A — SEB | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Guest finds SEB interesting within a positive big-bank case.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Part of a constructive sector view (~15% total return). Preferred over the pure net-interest banks because their premium has grown more.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates fall sharply
- if capital markets activity slumps

> *"Jag tycker SEB är intressant."*

---

### 🟢 DANSKE — Danske Bank | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest finds Danske Bank interesting.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion, part of the sector call for Nordic banks with stable earnings and high yields.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit losses rise

> *"Jag tycker att Danske Bank och DNB också är intressant."*

---

### 🟢 DNB — DNB Bank | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest finds DNB interesting.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion, part of the sector call for Nordic banks with stable earnings and high yields.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit losses rise

> *"Jag tycker att Danske Bank och DNB också är intressant."*

---

### 🟡 SWED-A — Swedbank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest is more cautious: a pure net-interest bank that has already re-rated more.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Nothing wrong operationally, but its premium has grown more than peers. Still, 'any bank will probably end up fairly right'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if net interest income falls with rate cuts

> *"Jag är lite mer försiktig till de renodlade räntenettobankerna som Swedbank och Handelsbanken."*

---

### 🟡 SHB-A — Handelsbanken | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest is more cautious because of its larger re-rating and pure net-interest profile.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. The premium has grown versus peers, but the sector is still attractive overall.

#### Sell Triggers

- if net interest income falls with rate cuts

> *"Jag är lite mer försiktig till de renodlade räntenettobankerna som Swedbank och Handelsbanken."*

---

### 🟢 SAND — Sandvik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest is still long despite a rating cut; the market underestimates the cyclical and machining potential.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Ålandsbanken holds the stock). Mining strength is well known, but the market underestimates the upside on the machining side. This goes against an analyst rating cut and mining stocks possibly near fair value.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the machining cycle fails to recover
- if the mining cycle turns

> *"Vi är fortfarande Långa Sandvik bland mycket annat. Vi tycker att man underskattar konjunkturpotentialen som finns."*

---

### 🟢 SKF-B — SKF | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The spin-off should unlock a higher multiple for the profitable industrial business, similar to Trelleborg.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: the industrial multiple has been held back by automotive, and analysts value SKF Industrial higher without the logo. The thesis requires an end to one-off costs and completion of the European footprint changes. The stock has already rallied strongly.

#### Sell Triggers

- if one-off costs keep recurring
- if the footprint restructuring drags on

> *"Men jag tror att det blir lättare att göra det trovärdigt utan att ha Vertevo med sig."*

---

### 🟢 SAAB-B — Saab | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Bank of America upgraded to buy, target SEK 720 vs SEK 633 price.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion (BofA), implying ~14% upside. The stock rose ~3% on the news. The hosts did not give their own view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the price reaches SEK 720
- if defence order intake slows

> *"där har Bank of America höjt rekommendationen till köp med en riktkurs på 720 kronor"*

---

### 🔴 TEL2-B — Tele2 | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Berenberg cut to sell from hold.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion only; the stock was at the bottom of the index. No host view.

> *"I botten har vi Tele2 som har fått en sänkt rekommendation från Berenberg Bank till sälj från tidigare behåll."*

---

### 🟡 ASKER — Asker Healthcare | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

DNB Carnegie upgraded to hold from sell because the price reached its target.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion. The upgrade is only valuation-driven because the price hit the target. The hosts praise the analyst's integrity.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the price runs well past the target

> *"nu tar de tillbaka till Hold eftersom kursen har nått deras riktkurs"*

---

### 🟠 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

New CEO; low valuation (8.5x EBIT) held back by Enterprise/Vonage and low growth.

#### Reasoning

Guest Jonathan Axelsson: Networks has strong margins but no growth, and Enterprise loses ~5bn a year. Closing or selling it could remove the burden. Catalysts: avoid big acquisitions, keep buybacks, Narvinger raising his own shareholding. No explicit buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a large acquisition is made
- if Networks momentum fades
- if Enterprise losses persist

> *"Ericsson värderas på 8,5 gånger ebit. Det är ingen hög värdering"*
